newsitem.title: MACAU: Senior Chinese official jumps to death -- papers.
newsitem.headline: Senior Chinese official jumps to death -- papers.

text.p: A senior Chinese official jumped 15 floors to his death from a building in the southern city of Guangzhou, newspapers in Macau reported on Thursday.

Zhong Zishuo, 53, formerly a senior official with China's mission in Portuguese-administered Macau, jumped from a building in front of his Guangzhou office earlier this week, pro-Beijing newspapers reported.
The papers said the reason for Zhong's suicide was unknown.
Officials at China's de facto embassy in Macau, the Xinhua News Agency, confirmed Zhong's death but declined further comment.

Zhong headed Xinhua's education, publicity, culture and sports section in Macau for almost four years until July, when he moved to Guangzhou after being appointed president of the city's Federation of Literary and Arts Circles.
Before his Macau posting, Zhong headed the Guangzhou provincial government's culture department.
